description_en: Binds a number to a fixed-line AXN private number. User A is assigned a dedicated private number X, and any number N can be forwarded to A by calling X. The fixed-line private number feature is currently available by invitation only. Contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
description_zh: 固话绑定AXN隐私号，是将A用户分配到一个专属的隐私号，任何号码N通过拨打X号码都可以转接到A。固话隐私号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi bind-axn-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --order-id 1230000000 --bind-type mode101 --subts 20161114143116 --tela '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --anucode 1,2,3 --expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAxnFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the number pool
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The binding type. Valid values:

mode101: The customer specifies the X number.

mode102: The platform assigns the X number
parameters.help_zh:
绑定类型，取值：

mode101：客户指定X号码。

mode102：平台分配X号码
parameters.name: bind_type

parameters.help_en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
The A number of the fixed-line AXN private number.


The A number can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code without a hyphen between the area code and the number.
To modify a bound number, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883049.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXN隐私号的A号码。


A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883049.html接口进行修改
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
The X number of the fixed-line AXN private number. The X number is a private number that you purchased in the console.

This parameter is required when the customer specifies the X number (BindType is set to mode101)
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXN隐私号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号。

客户指定X号码模式下（即BindType参数为mode101），本参数必填
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The N number of the fixed-line AXN private number
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 3 scenarios, in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

"1,2,3" means the B->X prompt code is 1, the A->X prompt code is 2, and the other numbers->X prompt code is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
The callee-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 2 scenarios, in the order of "A as callee, other numbers as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" means the prompt code when A answers is 1, and the prompt code when other numbers answer is 2
parameters.help_zh:
被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,其他号码被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，其他号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
The post-connection caller-side voice prompt codes. Must include codes for 2 scenarios, in the order of "A as callee, other numbers as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" means the caller-side prompt code when A is the callee is 1, and the caller-side prompt code when other numbers are the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,其他号码被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，其他号码被叫为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en: The area code. Specifies the location of the X number (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no location is specified, a number is randomly assigned nationwide
parameters.help_zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机
parameters.name: areacode

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time, in seconds. Valid values:

0: Never expires.

Other values: The binding remains valid for the specified duration after the X number is successfully assigned. For example, if set to 60, the binding is valid for 60 seconds and automatically unbound after that
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效；超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in call record receipt messages. The value cannot exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The callback control. A calls through X, meaning A is the caller and X is the called number. Valid values:

0 (default): Outbound calls are not allowed.

1: Connects to the most recent N number.

2: Calls back the fixed number TelB
fields.help_zh:
回拨控制。A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X。取值：

0（默认值）：不能外呼。

1：接续最近的N号码。

2：回拨固定号码TelB
fields.name: callback

fields.help_en:
The recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): Recording is disabled.

1: Recording is enabled.

After call recording is enabled, you can play and download voice files in call records. Recording files are billed at CNY 0.010 per minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。

开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording

0: Successful.

Code.description_zh:
接口请求状态码。取值：

0：成功。

其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59892.html）

Code.title_zh: 响应码 0：成功，其它失败，具体见文档

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
